verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a first-party API for programmatic access to the platform, with API-key authentication, official client libraries, and a Postman collection. Feature-specific APIs exist too, such as the evaluations API, but nothing documents parity with the UI, and some workflows (e.g. publishing evaluators) are described only as UI clicks. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or coverage matrix, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404s), and independent confirmation that UI-only actions are scriptable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Datadog API to access the Datadog platform programmatically.
Select one of our official [client libraries](/extend/community/libraries/) languages in each endpoint to see code examples from that library.
You can use the evaluations API provided by Agent Observability to send evaluations associated with spans, traces, or sessions to Datadog.
